edges.reason: lock() compares _owner with msg.sender through the onlyOwner modifier.
unlock() authorizes on _previousOwner == msg.sender without modifier.
renounceOwnership is gated by onlyOwner checks on msg.sender.
transferOwnership is gated by onlyOwner checks on msg.sender.
setIsBlacklisted is gated by onlyOwner checks on msg.sender.
setTaxFeePercent is gated by onlyOwner checks on msg.sender.
setMaxTxPercent is gated by onlyOwner checks on msg.sender.
setMaxWalletPercent is gated by onlyOwner checks on msg.sender.
excludeFromReward is gated by onlyOwner checks on msg.sender.
includeInReward is gated by onlyOwner checks on msg.sender.
transfer() uses _msgSender() as the from address.
transferFrom uses _msgSender() as spender for allowance decrement.
approve uses _msgSender() as the allowance owner.
Caller-derived addresses flow into _transfer from/to parameters.
Constructor credits _rTotal to _msgSender() making the deployer holder.
lock() computes _lockTime = now + time from block.timestamp.
unlock() requires now > _lockTime, making release time miner-influenced.
block.timestamp is forwarded as the swap deadline.
block.timestamp governs the ownership lock duration and release.
Timestamp-controlled lock/unlock reassigns the _owner state variable.
Timestamp arithmetic writes _lockTime.
Lock/unlock cycle reassigns _previousOwner.
lock() sets _owner to address(0), disabling onlyOwner functions.
lock() writes _lockTime.
lock() stores the current owner into _previousOwner.
unlock() restores _owner from _previousOwner.
unlock() reads _previousOwner for authorization and emission.
renounceOwnership writes _owner = address(0).
transferOwnership overwrites _owner with a new address.
setIsBlacklisted writes the isBlacklisted mapping.
setTaxFeePercent writes _taxFee used by all fee math.
setMaxTxPercent recomputes _maxTxAmount.
setMaxWalletPercent recomputes _maxWalletToken.
excludeFromReward pushes the account into the _excluded array.
excludeFromReward snapshots _tOwned from the reflection balance.
includeInReward mutates and pops the _excluded array.
includeInReward clears _tOwned for the account.
_transfer requires !isBlacklisted[from].
_transfer calls balanceOf(to) for _maxWalletToken enforcement.
_transfer dispatches to _tokenTransfer for fee-aware accounting.
_transfer derives the takeFee local from _isExcludedFromFee.
_transfer enforces amount <= _maxTxAmount.
_transfer enforces held tokens <= _maxWalletToken.
transfer() routes into the private _transfer implementation.
transferFrom routes into the private _transfer implementation.
transferFrom decrements the _allowances entry.
approve delegates to the private _approve.
_approve writes _allowances[owner][spender].
_tokenTransfer path computes t values via _getTValues.
_tokenTransfer path computes r values via _getRValues.
_getTValues applies _taxFee through calculateTaxFee.
_getTValues applies _devFee through calculateDevFee.
_getTValues applies _burnFee through calculateBurnFee.
Chained subtractions of fee amounts feed the reflection accounting.
Rate multiplication and subtraction produce reflection amounts.
Reflection math mutates _rOwned balances.
Reflection math mutates _tOwned balances.
_takeDevFee credits _rOwned[_devAddress].
_takeBurnFee credits _rOwned[_burnAddress].
_takeDevFee multiplies tDev by currentRate before adding.
_takeBurnFee multiplies tBurn by currentRate before adding.
deliver subtracts rAmount from the caller reflection balance.
deliver reduces _rTotal by the burned reflection amount.
swapTokensForEth calls the router and approves it on _allowances.
Swap executed with block.timestamp derived deadline.
swapTokensForEth builds the token pair path array.
Swap deadline argument originates from block.timestamp.
Low-level ETH call executes recipient code before state effects settle, enabling reentrant token balance manipulation.
Low-level call with value executes arbitrary target code with no reentrancy guard.
Constructor assigns _rTotal to _msgSender().
Constructor creates the Uniswap pair and stores uniswapV2Pair.
Constructor sets the immutable uniswapV2Router.
Constructor sets _isExcludedFromFee for owner, contract and dev.
balanceOf reads _rOwned for non-excluded accounts.
balanceOf reads _tOwned for excluded accounts.
deliver performs unchecked-invariant reflection subtraction on _rTotal.

normalization_plan.reason: time is only used to compute _lockTime inside lock().
newOwner exists solely as the target of the transferOwnership state update.
holder is the key written into isBlacklisted by setIsBlacklisted.
exempt is the value stored into isBlacklisted by setIsBlacklisted.
taxFee is directly assigned to the _taxFee state variable.
maxTxPercent is only used to recompute _maxTxAmount.
maxWalletToken is only used to recompute _maxWalletToken.
account is pushed into _excluded and snapshotted into _tOwned.
from selects the _rOwned/_tOwned debit side of the transfer.
to selects the _rOwned/_tOwned credit side and max wallet check.
amount bounds the transfer and drives fee computation.
tokenAmount is the swap input amount approved to the router.
path is a temporary array containing this token and WETH for the swap.
takeFee is derived from _isExcludedFromFee and passed to _tokenTransfer.
tAmount is decomposed into transfer, tax, dev and burn amounts.
account only selects the mapping entry returned by balanceOf.
